units.source_text: 却说其中有一个上了年纪的宫女，叫作源内侍，出身荣贵，才艺优越，人望也很高。

en.t: Among them was an elderly court lady named Gen no Naishi, who came from a noble family, excelled in the arts, and enjoyed a very high reputation.

units.source_text: 只是生性异常风流，在色情上完全不知自重。

en.t: But by nature she was extraordinarily amorous, and in matters of desire she had no sense of restraint at all.

units.source_text: 年纪恁般老大了，何以如此放荡？

en.t: How could someone so advanced in years still be so wanton?

units.source_text: 试把几句戏言来挑拨她一下，岂知她立刻有反应，毫不认为不相称。

en.t: He tried teasing her with a few playful words, only to find that she responded at once and saw nothing unsuitable about it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然觉得无聊，推想这种老女也许另有风味，便偷偷地和她私通了。

en.t: Although Prince Genji found it rather dull, he imagined that such an old woman might have a charm of her own, and secretly became intimate with her.

units.source_text: 但生怕外人得知，笑他搭交这些老物，因此表面上对她很疏远。

en.t: Yet he was afraid others would find out and laugh at him for consorting with such an old creature, so outwardly he kept very distant from her.
The old woman took this as a grievance.
